test: 2023–2025 regular seasons; one chronological evaluation, no tuning on this test
method: Opponent-adjusted point-margin ridge rating; previous-season ratings retain 60% of their prior value; 6-game ridge shrinkage; margins capped at 28; 0.97 weekly recency decay. Logistic coefficients fitted only on 2010–2021.
intervalNote: Paired game bootstrap; games are correlated, so interval is descriptive and may be optimistic.
playoffCalibration: Not backtested for playoff-event probabilities. Game-level results do not establish playoff-odds calibration.
